title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text:
I did the half day tour, visiting the bunkers at Charles Darwin NP, the ww2 Darwin bombing museum & harbour cruise.
Mariet is so knowledgeable about the attack and also took time to tell us about historic buildings on the way around. She also got the museum people to run the video presentation as soon as we arrived, to free us up to see the rest of the exhibits.
I had difficulty getting to the city for the 8am start (stayed out of town, missed bus, hitchhiked & walked) and Mariet was very kind and flexible, communicating well in helping me to join part-way. She even offered to take me back to the bunkers at the end, to cover the bit I missed.
The bunkers and museum are must-sees and the only improvement i could suggest is more time in the museum, there's a lot to see and learn about. Tho I acknowledge there's a schedule to catch the boat which other people do separately, so there's time pressure.
On the cruise David was very entertaining and it was great to get out on the water to see the city from a different perspective. There's actually not a lot of ww2 stuff to see out there, but the stories were great.
A long review but can I add big thanks to Lucy and Mariet for fitting me in and giving me a superb morning.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text:
We went on an absolutely amazing turtle tour with Sea Darwin-Sea Tiwi. One of the best wildlife experiences I have ever had and can't recommend enough. A really special place and experience, it was an honour to see the turtle mums laying their eggs and a few little hatchlings that hadn't made it out with their siblings, the beautiful bare sand and stars as we waited for them to come out of the water.
The process around not disturbing the turtles as much as possible was fantastic and the meal on board was healthy and delicious.
Apart from this we were absolutely humbled by how amazing and lovely the crew were. I was quite pregnant on the trip and would have understood if they declined to take me (particularly given how limited these spots are), instead they went to an extraordinary effort to accommodate me, including changing boats, and were so lovely about it. I felt quite embarrassed to have caused such effort but extremely grateful. The trip was an absolutely sensational experience and so grateful to have been able to go and experience such a special part of the world. Thank you very, very much to everyone involved.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text:
Did the WW2 by Land & Sea half day tour with Ferry cruise. Picked up at 8 am from esplanade accom with first stop at Survivor's Lookout nearby, then a sight seeing drive through city, premier Bayview & marina suburbs, paspaley pearl origins & checked out Darwin National Park with its hidden ammunition bunkers & scenic lookout. Followed by the WW2 Bombing of Darwin ferry cruise. Then East Point area drive past plus 1.5 hours stop at Darwin Military Museum. Finally dropped off where we wanted to be - Darwin waterfront Stokes Hill wharf. About 4.5 hrs tour - think I have covered it order of sequence..

Enjoyed it all -  guide & driver Trevor was informative & obliging with a welcome esky of icy bottled water which I felt like dousing myself with to cool off..🤓

On the harbour cruise, lucky us got to ferry past the majestic & biggest aircraft carrier in the British Navy - HMS Prince of Wales which had docked only 2 days before for a large scale military exercise with multiple nations. Port of Darwin & naval base flies under the radar in history & in the news but was & is a strategic defence base. Darwin Harbour is 60 x bigger than Sydney Harbour.

This guided tour & cruise was an eye opener & by the time my first visit to Darwin came to an end, I transformed into an enlightened Darwin devotee!

Ferry cruise included Anzac bikie handout & 5 mins bobbing over the sunken grave of WW2 casualties. A small TV screen in front of ferry showed sonar imaging of these vessels which made little sense & those at the back wld have visually blanked. A poignant Remembrance moment totally lost on us.

Instead of this meaningless offering - how about projecting an actual undersea video of these WW2 sunken ships a la Titanic & request a minute silence in remembrance & then distribute the bikies? A larger TV screen is needed. Can you Sea Darwin - this wld be a fitting tribute..👌🏽👌🏽✨️✨️

My personal 'favourite' part of the tour was when we were told we were going to a shipwreck - I thought we'd see parts of the boat sticking out of the water, perhaps some rusty masts. Instead, we were at the site, tilting our heads up to look at a screen of an infrared map to 'see it on the seabed'... it looked more like a mountain than a boat. Turtle tracks tour - I think this is the best tour I've ever been on. Our guides were brilliant, so knowledgeable and respectful of all the wildlife. We saw about 40 tiny turtles emerging from their nest, a beautiful thing to witness! Because it wasn't dark enough to release them, they were put in a canvas bag and given to my partner for safe keeping and warmth! So sweet. We then saw a mama turtle dig a nest and lay her eggs.
Releasing the babies under the milky way was an experience I'll never forget.
The boat ride back included food and drinks, which were lush!
We'd highly recommend Sea Darwin for their tours, and if we're ever in the Top End again, we'll be sure to book another 😊

Once on the island, our minds were blown!  We lost count of how many turtles we saw wandering up to the dunes to lay their eggs. title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Ik heb de Turtle Track tour gedaan. Heel gave tour waarbij je de flatbacks kan zien nesten op het strand. Voor zonsondergang hebben de gidsen eerst een net uitgekomen nest voor ons uitgegraven om te kijken of er nog schildpadden waren die niet uit het nest konden komen maar wel in leven waren. Helaas geen geluk. Maar het was wel interessant om dit te zien. Daarna toen de zon onder was zochten we een schildpad die kwam nesten. Na even wachten kwam ze het steand op en begon rustig met een plekje vinden voor haar nest. De gidsen (die overigens heel veel kennis hadden over de schildpadden (PhD))  volgde dit van dichtbij tot ze begon met graven. Toen mochten wij ook dichterbij komen om het te zien. Wit licht en veel beweging zou de schildpadden storen/afschrikken in deze fase van het nesten dus het was dan ook erg jammer dat een aantal touristen zich niet aan de instructies hielden en er soms toch ergens een wit lichtje aan ging (hoe moeilijk kan het zijn denk je dan). Maar goed, toen de schildpad klaar was om haar eieren te leggen gebeurde er iets (of de gids deed te vroeg haar witte licht aan of er viel zand terug het nest in) waardoor ze besloot een heel nieuw nest te maken. Het vergt veel geduld deze tour omdat het erg lang duurt voor ze een goed nest heeft gemaakt en klaar is om de eieren te leggen. Maar de gidsen en de schipper wachtten het rustig af en gaven ons extra tijd om het toch helemaal te kunnen zien gelukkig. Ik vond het in elk geval een prachtige eraring! Heel bijzonder om dit zo in alle rust te mogen ervaren. Al het geduld meer dan waard! Juist het geduld en de rust maakt het ook zo bijzonder

It was terrific value and we would highly recommend the tour to all and sundry. Sue & Jeff

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: We absolutely enjoyed our cruise, staff were so friendly and informative.  Made you feel relaxed from the time you set foot aboard.  Great way to end our Darwin experience

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text:
The cruise was extraordinary.  The food, the music, the SeaDarwin members & the view :) At sunset it looks like fire on the sky.

I was there on the end of February and jackets were not required even in the sea.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text:
This cruise was BRILLIANT fish and chips fresh and delicious. Not greasy or fatty but gourmet. A real meal. Whilst the cruise has been a highlight of our trip to Darwin.
Maureen Melbourne

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Sensational evening cruise with captain Jim and his agile crew. Great fish and chips accompanied with an informative commentary. Took this cruise with recommendation from family, ticks all the KPI's

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Awesome.  Great Skipper and Crew was incredible.  Looked after us well. Great Dinner. We did see turtles.  Was truly awesome.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Their sunset cruise is the best way to see a Darwin sunset, aboard the boat eating fish n chips. It is a big serve of delicious food, so come hungry. One complimentary drink on embarking and cheap drinks to buy on board, $3 softdrink, $7 alcoholic. They give an excellent commentary along the way and do some fancy speedboat twirls and tricks at the end. A great evening all round, thanks so much.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: This was probably one of the best attractions in Darwin great service, great fish and chips great service from the skipper Jim and his crew. A sensational cruise. Do yourself a favour when your in Darwin do not miss this great attraction.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Went there with Sea Darwin for a turtle watching tour.  We had an amazing experience with a turtle come right up the beach in front of us to lay it's eggs. Combined with the guide finding a nest of baby turtles we all an up close and personal view.  The guides are a font of information and great at educating us on the turtles.  The boat ride out to the island  was beautiful and the dinner on the way back was delicious.  I can whole heartedly recommend this tour.

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Highly recommend their sunset, fish n Chips cruise. Rob and his two assistants are very accommodating! Rob is a well if knowledge and a very capable skipper! His commentary is hilarious too. Fish and chips was spot on!! Fresh snapper :D thanks Rach!

title: Sea Darwin - Sea Tiwi
text: Highly recommend this cruise!! The crew were so friendly and full of amazing knowledge, its great value for money +++++
